messages.subject: Cedar - lease review findings
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Lease review done. Key points: (1) Units 6 and 7 have rent-free periods to 24 March 2026 - we should get a top-up / apportionment in the buyer's favour; (2) Units 3 and 5 have tenant break options in 2026, worth flagging to the client for the income assumptions; (3) Unit 4 rent deposit (£45k + VAT) needs a new rent deposit deed to transfer to Thornbury; (4) the Unit 5 tenant has an open service-charge query (~£6.3k) - we should ask Birchall Stone to resolve or indemnify before completion.

Tenancy schedule ties to £1,062,500 passing. NIY ~7.0% grossed up for costs.

Elena
